basics.name: Omar Boza
basics.label: Senior Web Developer | Tech Lead | Webflow, WordPress, React, Next.js | PHP, JavaScript, CSS | AI Automation
basics.summary: Senior web developer and Tech Lead teams escalate to for feasibility calls, WordPress root-cause, and hard delivery — with strong PHP, CSS, and JavaScript on Webflow and WordPress, plus React and Next.js for full-stack products. Made the call that seat-level booking could ship inside WordPress; recovered a year-delayed web + mobile product by resyncing drifted stacks and shipping in 3 months; was the WordPress and front-end reference at Your Digital Resource. Ships faster with agentic AI (Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, MCP) for US clients. Fluent in English (EF SET C2) and Spanish. Based in Managua, Nicaragua.

work.name: Your Digital Resource
work.summary: Team escalation point for WordPress and front-end; AI-powered Webflow/WordPress delivery and performance optimization for client communication projects.
highlights: Was the team's reference for WordPress and front-end: unusual WordPress behavior, multi-layer cache issues that hid shipped changes, and Webflow/CSS blockers got escalated to me; onboarded new developers and coached the team through technical stuck points.
Diagnosed and fixed multi-layer cache issues that made correct deployments look like failed changes, then optimized the layers so the problem stopped recurring.
Pioneered AI-assisted Webflow/WordPress workflows across dozens of landing pages, cutting repetitive editing work from days to a couple of hours.
Diagnosed client-site performance issues and built AI-driven optimization that moved sites from GTmetrix Grade F to A, cutting the process from 90 to 20 minutes.
Created an open-source Client-First Agent Skill that encodes Finsweet Client-First conventions so AI tools can generate Webflow components automatically instead of by hand.

work.name: Nicasource
work.summary: Full-stack web development for international clients using modern JavaScript frameworks; feasibility calls on complex WordPress requirements.
highlights: Made the feasibility call that a client seat-reservation system could ship inside WordPress — modeling seats, availability, and bookings with custom post types and meta — instead of a separate application the team would have to sync forever.
Owned web development delivery using React, Vue, and WordPress for international client requirements.
Contributed to frontend architecture, reusable component design, and performance optimization across concurrent projects.

work.name: AIM Services

Owned architecture and delivery for company projects, including a dual web/mobile application built with Ionic.
